sloka: विक्रान्तस्य आर्य शीलस्य सम्युगेषु अनिवर्तिनः ।स्नुषा दशरथस्य एषा ज्येष्ठा राज्ञो यशस्विनी ॥५-१६-१७॥
transliteration: vikrāntasya ārya śīlasya samyugeṣu anivartinaḥ ।snuṣā daśarathasya eṣā jyeṣṭhā rājño yaśasvinī ॥5-16-17॥

translations.english: "This celebrated lady is the eldest daughterinlaw of the noble, valiant king Dasaratha who never returned from the battleground without being victorious.
